reproduction.method: The pinned POSIX recipe and all 27 component source archives were built into a new controlled deps/target directory. No prior compiled object or installed native dependency prefix was reused. All three directory patches and the official libheif setting were applied before compilation. The actual corresponding-source tarball was then unpacked into another fresh directory; its own build entry point successfully prepared all inputs, and its own verifier validated both artifacts without repository-only imports.
